title: EdgeCount Package Tutorial
text: EdgeCount package provides statistical framework enrichment analysis based graph connectedness. designed large, sparse graphs, protein interaction networks, social networks, term-element membership graphs (bipartite graphs). package’s methodology combines Random Graph Given Expected Degrees (RGGED) model (Chung Lu 2002) analytical expressions connectedness effect size p-value (Pradines et al. 2005). also introduces Vertex Set Enrichment Analysis (VSEA), permutation-based method similar GSEA (Subramanian et al. 2005). VSEA uniquely accounts degree element (.e., number terms element belongs ). primary functions allow users : Evaluate graph’s suitability EdgeCount statistical models. Test internal connectedness within one sets. Test connectedness pairs sets. Score collection terms single set data table element sets. Perform Vertex Set Enrichment Analysis (VSEA) ranked list elements. Summarize VSEA results Normalized Enrichment Scores (NES) FDR q-values.
